safeClaims: GCA has a live public access API for email registration, contact suppression, access config, member access, device-key account status, and read-only wallet verification.
The member access API is live on Cloudflare Workers + D1 and uses gca_member_access_v2 with a browser-generated device status key.
POST /gca/account-status returns a read-only redacted status snapshot after matching the SHA-256 hash of the device key; it does not return email, the full wallet address, or the key.

POST /gca/account-service-requests lets the device-key authenticated account queue one catalog service for manual review; the server selects the catalog unit and submission does not reserve or deduct credits.

POST /gca/account-service-requests/status returns only that account's redacted service, title, status, time, public more-information prompt, follow-up timestamp and count, credit-check history, and the non-sensitive delivery reference after completed delivery, without returning email, the device key, the full request body, private operator note, or follow-up response text.

POST /gca/account-service-requests/follow-ups lets the matched device-key account answer a public more-information prompt with one bounded append-only response; exact retries are idempotent, each request is limited to five responses, and submission only returns the request to manual review.

POST /gca/account-service-requests/cancellations lets that device-key authenticated account permanently cancel its own queued request before manual review; retries are idempotent and cancellation changes no credits, wallet, token, member, or trading-permission state.

POST /gca/account-service-requests/delivery-receipts lets that device-key authenticated account acknowledge completed delivery once; retries are idempotent and the receipt changes no credits, wallet, token, member, or trading-permission state.
Manual service decisions are stored as append-only gca_service_request_review_v1 records; delivery requires prior approval.
A delivered request uses the server catalog credit unit and can create at most one linked credit usage record.
The account history returns the latest redacted review, credit settlement, and non-sensitive delivery reference after completed delivery without reviewer identity or operator notes.
The Worker verifies Base Mainnet GCA balances with read-only eth_call and ERC-20 balanceOf.
Eligible 10,000 GCA holders can create one 100 GCA AI Quant Access credits ledger record.
GCA operators can record reviewed service-level credit usage against an existing credit ledger through the live token-protected Worker route; anonymous reads are rejected.
GCA operators can queue service scope requests through the live token-protected Worker route before delivery; queued requests do not deduct credits or create trading permission.
Eligible 1,000,000 GCA / 30-day holders can create a GCA Member review ledger record.
Submitted holding dates and transaction hashes are preview evidence only; member activation requires a token-protected manual operator review.

Successful GCA Member approval now also requires an observed complete 30-day GCA transfer-history reconstruction using Base Blockscout v2 plus recent Base public RPC logs and a snapshot balanceOf read.
Successful approval stores append-only gca_holding_verification_v1 evidence with the observed minimum balance and links it to the review and member ledger.
Production member review decisions are stored as append-only D1 records, while member and account status updates run in one D1 batch transaction.

After an operator manually completes an approved transfer, the protected production route verifies and stores gca_member_benefit_transfer_v1 evidence from the official reserve wallet to the approved member wallet.
Member-benefit transfer evidence requires a successful receipt at or below the Base safe block and exactly 10,000 GCA in one matching Transfer log.
The API contract forbids private keys, seed phrases, exchange API secrets, withdrawal permission, custody, and risk-control bypass.
The 10,000 GCA member benefit remains manual reserve-wallet processing; the production API records verified evidence after the transfer and does not send tokens.
The official public market route is the Base Mainnet Uniswap v4 GCA/USDT pool.
doNotClaim: credits or member status are cash, income, reimbursement, trading permission, or transferable value
credit usage is public self-service redemption, cash settlement, or automatic wallet action
a service request queue record means service delivery, credit deduction, trading permission, or wallet action has already happened
an approved service request means delivery has happened or credits have already been deducted
cancelling a queued service request is a refund, credit restoration, wallet action, token transfer, deletion of audit history, or cancellation after manual review
the service review route can deduct credits more than once for the same service request
a delivery receipt is a refund, a new credit deduction, a wallet action, a token transfer, a delivery dispute resolution, or trading permission
GCA Member approval is automatic without wallet balance and 30-day holding-period review
the observed holding-history reconstruction is a third-party security audit, permanent guarantee, or proof that public index data can never be delayed
the 10,000 GCA member benefit is automatic or self-service transferred
the production member-benefit evidence route signs, authorizes, or broadcasts a token transfer
the account-status endpoint returns email, the full wallet address, the device key, administrator data, or operator notes
a lost or expired device key can be recovered without official support verification
an account service request means delivery is approved, credits are reserved or deducted, a wallet action occurred, or trading permission was created
the API collects private keys, seed phrases, exchange API secrets, withdrawal permission, custody, or one-time codes
API access provides live order execution or risk-control bypass
